integrity: A complete analytic proof of the strict balancing factorization is included; independent exact-rational and symbolic programs are provided. Computational samples are not treated as infinite proofs. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only exactly three identically weighted exceptional rungs on a unit-rail circular ladder with at least five rungs. No result for arbitrary defect multiplicities, unequal strengths, or wider strips. Historical-priority confirmation remains provisional.
title: Universal spacing extrema for three weighted rungs of a circular ladder
